set.body:
## Scope
Place activity production at shared operation boundaries used by the CLI, Python API, and MCP, rather than only at daemon or CLI interception. Record request, accepted/rejected/unknown outcome, scheduler observation, artifact observation, validation, campaign change, and attention events with causal correlation.

## Acceptance criteria
- The CLI, Python API, and MCP produce equivalent attributable activity facts for the same submit, refresh, retry, cancel, validate, and inspect operations.
- One logical operation has stable correlation/cause identifiers across request, response, subsequent scheduler evidence, and resulting campaign/attention projections.
- Submission acceptance is recorded before any later campaign-view update; an interruption after acceptance leaves enough durable evidence for passive recovery.
- Attempt-specific scheduler evidence remains scoped to the attempt that produced it; a retry cannot inherit identity evidence from the prior attempt.
- Instrumentation is additive and does not change authorization, retry eligibility, or scheduler mutation behavior.
- Tests exercise direct calls and MCP calls, lost response after dispatch/acceptance, retries separated in time, arrays, and packed units.
set.title: A2.1: instrument shared operation boundaries for all clients
